# `production-ops` branch starts the job, which then WAITS for Chad to approve it
# in GitHub (Environments -> production). Nothing runs without that click.
#   check     - read-only: confirm the target is crew-clock-prod and print its state
#   migrate   - apply every migration with the checked script, mark it production

action=check
